name: 阿米亚特
evolution: 阿米亚特 → 阿米樱 Lv.30 → 罗隐 Lv.50 → 深渊罗隐
evolutionEn: Amiyate → Amiying Lv.30 → Luoyin Lv.50 → Shenyuanluoyin
description: 全身都是岩石，但眼睛周围没有岩石保护，是十分脆弱的柔软皮肤。喜欢吃不同口味的矿石，总是静静呆着，没什么存在感。
descriptionEn: Its whole body is rock, but the skin around its eyes is unprotected soft skin that is very fragile. It likes to eat ores of different flavors, always staying still and having little presence.

skills.name: 魔爪
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。

skills.name: 鸣沙陷阱
skills.description: 造成物伤，物防比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the higher its physical defense vs the enemy's, the higher this skill's power.

skills.name: 力量吞噬
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能威力-20，自己获得全技能威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains -20 to all skill power; self gains +20 to all skill power.

skills.name: 岩土暴击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每被攻击1次。本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; each time it is attacked, this skill's energy cost permanently -1.

skills.name: 砂石冲撞
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，自己获得物防+100%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the enemy switches spirits this turn, gains +100% physical defense.

skills.name: 泥浆铠甲
skills.description: 自己获得物攻和物防+60%，应对防御：额外使自己的增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains +60% physical attack and physical defense; counter defense: additionally doubles its own buffs.

skills.name: 暗突袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，吸血50%，应对状态：本次技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, lifesteals 50%; counter state: this skill's power doubles.

skills.name: 地刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; counter state: additionally interrupts the countered skill.

skills.name: 地震
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.
